scanner_review.kingfisher: Pinned 1.4.0 SDK Scanner.scan_input, Rules(cache=False); no Validator/Revoker.
scanner_review.trufflehog: Pinned 3.92.5 stdin with --no-verification --no-update --force-skip-archives --no-verification-cache --fail-on-scan-errors; Verified must be false.
scanner_review.negative_proof: Both engines must complete; unavailable/failed/version-mismatched detectors cannot establish clean content. Finding limits, process timeout and output caps are enforced.
scanner_review.redaction_dedup: Exact matched bytes receive process-random HMAC fingerprints; both engines and service owners deduplicate by value. Fingerprints do not identify or verify credentials across runs. Raw output and exception text are discarded, paths pseudonymized/redacted and retained metadata scrubbed.
scanner_review.cleanup: Readers close responses/sessions in finally; archive/image/Git parsing is bounded in memory without filesystem extraction or execution. TruffleHog stderr is discarded and its process group is killed on timeout before streams close. Raw content is not cached; only bounded redacted successful scanner outcomes may be cached.
